Human-readable `reason` text may evolve without changing UI behavior.

`planner` when the snapshot is backed by resolved planner capabilities;

status.description: Capability availability does not imply scientific qualification.

bounds.description:
Physical cell-edge bounds in meters. For structured FDM grids, `min`
is the grid edge origin and `max` is `origin + shape * spacing`.
Cell centers are offset by `spacing / 2` on non-zero axes.

bounds_min_m.description: Cell-edge AABB of the exact active-cell mask in meters.

grid_fingerprint.description: Grid identity used to compute this exact support summary.

FdmMultilayerLayoutResource.description:
Thin, revision-driven description of the native carriers used by an FDM
multilayer convolution.  The common transform layout is an FFT scratch
layout and must never be interpreted as a physical mesh.

requested_common_cell_size.description: Author-requested common convolution-grid resolution in meters.

FdmNativeLayerRegionMembershipResource.description:
Thin control-plane descriptor for one native multilayer FDM membership.
The cell-aligned IDs remain on the companion FMRM binary resource.

FdmRegionLegendEntryResource.description:
Thin descriptor for realized FDM cell membership. The mask itself is kept
on the binary data plane under the companion FMRM resource.

oneOf.description:
Exact realized magnetic-support summary. Missing on legacy artifacts;
consumers must then keep outside-support presentation fail-closed.

FieldAvailabilityResource.description:
Target-scoped field availability. Unlike [`FieldCatalog`], this resource
proves readiness for one concrete target/scope carrier; it deliberately
does not include frontend renderer adoption state.

scope.description: Compatibility projection of `scope_kind` for existing clients.

oneOf.description: Same runner-owned capability resource returned by the quantity catalog.

source_time_seconds.description: Solver time in seconds for the state that produced this field, when known.

spatial.description: Whether this descriptor can be rendered as a spatial viewport field.

ui_exposed.description: Whether this canonical quantity is intended for interactive UI selection.

oneOf.description: Same runner-owned capability resource returned by the quantity catalog.

source_time_seconds.description: Solver time in seconds for the state that produced this field, when known.

FieldPublicationBundle.description:
Atomic identity envelope for one field response. A consumer must accept or
reject the whole bundle; individual revision or carrier members are not a
valid publication on their own.

cut_kind.description: How the cut position was specified: `"normalized"` or `"world"`.

cut_world.description: Resolved cut in world coordinates (m), if domain bounds are known.

etag.description: Stable fingerprint covering all resolved parameters (ETag for the meta resource).

sampling_method.description:
Sampling path used to construct this slice.

Examples: `fdm_nearest`, `fem_fallback_fdm_nearest`.

slice_revision.description: Stable fingerprint covering all resolved parameters.

x_pixels.description: Pixel width of the slice grid.

y_pixels.description: Pixel height of the slice grid.

FieldVectorPendingResponse.description:
JSON response returned while a requested field vector is being materialized.

The stable `reason_code` and `retry_after_ms` fields let clients retry a
pending resource without parsing an error message. The `generation_id`
identifies the domain generation for which materialization is pending.

command_id.description: Active compute-fields command, when one owns the materialization.

reason_code.description: Stable reason code suitable for client-side diagnostics.

retry_after_ms.description: Recommended delay before retrying the same resource request.

component.description:
Component to return.

Accepted values: `full` (default), `magnitude`, `x`, `y`, `z`, `c0`, `c1`, …, `cN-1`.

- `full` → full interleaved vector (nComp unchanged)
- `magnitude` → per-point L2 norm (nComp=1)
- `x`/`y`/`z`/`cN` → single component by index (nComp=1)

expected_carrier_revision.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency precondition for the resolved field carrier.

expected_generation_id.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency precondition for the domain generation.

geometry_scope.description:
Optional geometric subset for scoped vector samples.

Accepted values: `full` (default) and `surface`. `surface` is currently
Accepted values: `full` (default) and `surface`. `surface` is currently
supported for `airbox` scope and is resolved from the union of the
selected air-part surface-node memberships before `max_samples` is applied.

max_samples.description:
Optional positive hard cap for vector samples returned by the binary payload.

When `max_samples=K` is supplied, the response contains at most `K`
deterministic samples. FMVP v3 carries `sampled_node_indices` (FEM) or
explicit cell ordinals/native-grid provenance (FDM), so sampled vectors
remain placeable on their source carrier. This applies to full-domain
regular-grid FDM as well as scoped FDM and multilayer native-grid
requests. Without a cap, a full-domain FDM response remains the complete
cell-centred field and may use the legacy FMVP v2 representation.

A value of zero is invalid and returns HTTP 400. Raw FEM nodal coloring
still requires complete field coverage even when vector glyph transport
is sampled.

owner_object_id.description:
Optional canonical owner of a `region` scope.

Required when the current single-grid FDM membership has the same
`region_id` under more than one magnetic object. It is ignored by
globally unique region IDs to preserve existing unqualified requests.

scope_id.description:
Scope identifier for `object`, `region`, and `part` scopes. For `airbox`,
omit it or use `airbox` for the aggregate, or pass an explicit air-part id.

scope_kind.description:
Optional FEM or FDM scope for large-domain samples.

Accepted values: `full`, `object`, `region`, `part`, `layer`, `airbox`,
`selection`. Single-grid FDM supports `object`, `region`, and `airbox`
from current FMRM membership. Multilayer FDM supports native `layer`
and `object` scopes without projecting payloads onto the common grid.
`object` and `part` require `scope_id`; `airbox` may omit it and resolves
to the aggregate of all FEM mesh parts with role `air`, while an explicit
Airbox mesh-part `scope_id` selects exactly that part; `selection` resolves
from the current workspace selection.

snapshot_id.description:
Optional persisted analysis snapshot id, for example a saved
hysteresis-point magnetization state.

stage_id.description:
Optional hysteresis stage id that owns `snapshot_id`.

When present, the data-plane reader validates that the requested
snapshot appears in that stage's hysteresis point history before
loading persisted magnetization data.

view.description:
Optional complex analysis view for frequency-domain fields.

Accepted values for analysis fields: `complex`, `full`, `real`, `imag`,
`abs`, `amplitude`, `phase`, `phase_rotated_real`.

conservative_current_view.description:
Optional explicit accepted RT0/H(div) source descriptor.  It remains a
JSON object at the scene boundary so every closure field survives UI
round-trip; the planner performs mesh-exact typed validation.

oneOf.description:
Authored FDM closed-current intent. Grid face indices and runtime
certificate state are resolved later and never enter the scene model.

capabilities.description: Canonical UI gating source for the current session. Platform and meshing capabilities have narrower ownership.

display.description: Current renderer/view selection. The writable display resource is `visualization/display`.

domain.description: Thin domain summary for adapter selection. Heavy topology is owned by `data/domain/topology` and meshing mesh resources.

energies.description: Thin latest energy summary for status surfaces. Energy samples/history are owned by `simulation/solver/energies/*`.

lifecycle.description:
Independent solver, session-resource, connectivity, and commandability
state. Consumers must not derive commandability from solver state.

metrics.description: Lightweight runtime metrics for status surfaces. Detailed logs/diagnostics live under `diagnostics/*`.

resources.description: Revision pointers used to invalidate resource hooks. Heavy resources must be fetched from their owning endpoint.

oneOf.description: Thin run summary for header/status surfaces. Full run metadata is owned by `simulation/runs/*`.

session.description: Thin current-session summary. Full session persistence state is owned by persistence resources.

solver.description: Thin solver summary for polling cadence and top-bar state. Detailed solver state is owned by `simulation/solver/status`.

active_build.description: Current active build descriptor and progress metadata.

effective_airbox_target.description: Resolved target for the current build. Summary-level copies are transitional dashboard projections.

effective_per_object_targets.description: Resolved per-object targets for the current build. Summary-level copies are transitional dashboard projections.

last_build_summary.description: Current/last build summary for build panels. Latest-success endpoint owns stable successful build references.

oneOf.description:
Failure evidence from the latest mixed-layer build attempt. This is not
a solver-accepted topology certificate.

policy_diff.description: Typed policy change summary for UI diff tables.

oneOf.description: Typed provenance for the accepted mesh build intent and realized mesh output.
Typed resource revisions and URLs published by the backend after build completion.

resolved_policy.description: Resolved policy used by the build. This is execution reality, not the authoring draft.

oneOf.description: Typed shared-domain build report extracted from the latest build summary when present.

last_build_summary.description: Detailed latest build summary for diagnostics and inspectors.

mesh_pipeline_status.description: Detailed build pipeline state for diagnostics and build panels.

mesh_quality_summary.description: Detailed mesh-build quality diagnostics. Dashboard quality summaries are transitional projections only.

mesh_statistics.description: Full mesh statistics report for realized solver mesh diagnostics.

mesh_adaptivity_state.description: Meshing adaptivity capability/state only. UI-wide gating remains owned by `status.capabilities`.

oneOf.description: Meshing policy/build feature matrix only. UI-wide gating remains owned by `status.capabilities`.

effective_airbox_target.description: Transitional target projection retained for current frontend adapters.

effective_per_object_targets.description: Transitional target projection retained for current frontend adapters.

last_success.description: Last successful build artifact/reference summary. It must not become a copy of the active build resource.

config.description: User-authored per-object mesh policy exactly as committed in the scene.

effective_config.description: Effective policy projection with backend defaults merged for inspectors.

segment_id.description:
Stable content-addressed fallback carrier id. Object segments remain
diagnostic geometry and are never field-capable carriers.

status.description:
Aggregate certificate/resource status. `valid` is reserved for a
current accepted v6 certificate with complete pair diagnostics.

freshness.description: `current` applies only to certified mesh membership; `preview` is analytic projection.

owner_object_id.description:
Canonical scene-object owner. Together with `region_id` this is the
stable authored-region identity.

region_membership_revision.description: Independent region-membership realization revision, not the scene journal revision.

topology_fingerprint.description: Stable identity of the mesh topology used for this membership.

oneOf.description: Transitional diagnostics projection retained for current frontend adapters. New consumers should use build/quality/report resources.

universe_config.description: Solver-domain universe mesh policy. This endpoint owns mesh semantics, not build diagnostics.

mesh_parts.description: Scoped mesh parts for object/airbox/selection fetches. Heavy topology remains in binary topology endpoints.

oneOf.description: Immutable requested-vs-realized report for this mesh build revision.

effective_airbox_target.description: Transitional dashboard target summary. Build-specific target resolution is owned by `meshing/builds/current`.

effective_per_object_targets.description: Transitional dashboard target summary. Build-specific target resolution is owned by `meshing/builds/current`.

Stable scope reference used by the graph-driven model tree.

The graph endpoint intentionally exposes scope and dependency metadata,
while constitutive family payloads remain on the family resources.

field_backend.description: Backend that materialized the field carrier, when the runtime publishes it.

field_device.description: Device that materialized the field carrier, when the runtime publishes it.

PlanarSampleSourceResource.description:
The resolved data-plane source.  `Default` is a session presentation
source and deliberately has no monitor ID; `Monitor` is the authored

`Default` is a presentation source resolved from the current domain. It is
intentionally not a monitor identity and is never written into the scene

capability_state.description: Capability of the resolved backend/plan, independent of field cache.

materializable.description: Whether the current plan can materialize this quantity on demand.

renderable.description: Whether the current UI renderer supports this quantity shape without coercion.

solver_capability.description: Solver/provider capability plane, independent of request and payload state.

algorithm.description: Generic resolved solver realization (for example a frequency-domain engine).

max_rhs_norm_per_s.description: Maximum total dynamic RHS norm in 1/s. This is not an equilibrium torque.

max_torque.description:
Deprecated ambiguous alias. When present it is always in A/m and equals
`max_torque_Apm`.
Deprecated ambiguous alias. When present it is in A/m.

allOf.description:
Acknowledged as terminally rejected until the runtime owns a safe
execution-plan replanning lifecycle for FDM grid and membership data.

Acknowledged as terminally rejected until the runtime owns a safe
execution-plan replanning lifecycle for FDM grid and membership data.

origin.description:
Physical grid edge origin in meters. Cell centers are
`origin + (i + 0.5) * spacing` on non-zero axes.

TargetFieldAvailabilityState.description:
Backend availability states intentionally stop at `ready`; `adopted` is a
renderer/frontend fact and must not be inferred from an HTTP resource.

TopologicalChargeMethod.description: The single production discretization method for schema v2.

TopologicalChargePlane.description:
The ordered support plane.  The canonical `(u, v, n)` frame is published in
the response because `xz` has normal `-y`, not `+y`.

TopologicalChargeProfileSamples.description:
A bounded request for exact profile cuts.

Query parameters are strings, so deserialization accepts `auto` and decimal
integers only.  The numeric bounds are enforced at the public boundary.

TopologicalChargeQueryV2.description: Typed query for the v2 analysis resource.

TopologicalChargeResourceV2.description: Versioned resource published by the topological-charge endpoint.

TopologicalChargeStatus.description:
Expected scientific computation states.  Transport lifecycle is intentionally
absent: `idle`, `loading`, `stale`, and `error` belong to the resource hook.

TopologicalChargeSupportMode.description: Whether the result represents one exact midplane or a thickness profile.

TopologicalChargeTrust.description:
Scientific trust is intentionally distinct from whether computation produced
a finite diagnostic integral.

parameters.description:
Component to return.

Accepted values: `full` (default), `magnitude`, `x`, `y`, `z`, `c0`, `c1`, …, `cN-1`.

- `full` → full interleaved vector (nComp unchanged)
- `magnitude` → per-point L2 norm (nComp=1)
- `x`/`y`/`z`/`cN` → single component by index (nComp=1)
parameters.name: component

parameters.description:
Optional FEM or FDM scope for large-domain samples.

Accepted values: `full`, `object`, `region`, `part`, `layer`, `airbox`,
`selection`. Single-grid FDM supports `object`, `region`, and `airbox`
from current FMRM membership. Multilayer FDM supports native `layer`
and `object` scopes without projecting payloads onto the common grid.
`object` and `part` require `scope_id`; `airbox` may omit it and resolves
to the aggregate of all FEM mesh parts with role `air`, while an explicit
Airbox mesh-part `scope_id` selects exactly that part; `selection` resolves
from the current workspace selection.
parameters.name: scope_kind

parameters.description:
Scope identifier for `object`, `region`, and `part` scopes. For `airbox`,
omit it or use `airbox` for the aggregate, or pass an explicit air-part id.
parameters.name: scope_id

parameters.description:
Optional canonical owner of a `region` scope.

Required when the current single-grid FDM membership has the same
`region_id` under more than one magnetic object. It is ignored by
globally unique region IDs to preserve existing unqualified requests.
parameters.name: owner_object_id

parameters.description:
Optional geometric subset for scoped vector samples.

Accepted values: `full` (default) and `surface`. `surface` is currently
Accepted values: `full` (default) and `surface`. `surface` is currently
supported for `airbox` scope and is resolved from the union of the
selected air-part surface-node memberships before `max_samples` is applied.
parameters.name: geometry_scope

parameters.description:
Optional positive hard cap for vector samples returned by the binary payload.

When `max_samples=K` is supplied, the response contains at most `K`
deterministic samples. FMVP v3 carries `sampled_node_indices` (FEM) or
explicit cell ordinals/native-grid provenance (FDM), so sampled vectors
remain placeable on their source carrier. This applies to full-domain
regular-grid FDM as well as scoped FDM and multilayer native-grid
requests. Without a cap, a full-domain FDM response remains the complete
cell-centred field and may use the legacy FMVP v2 representation.

A value of zero is invalid and returns HTTP 400. Raw FEM nodal coloring
still requires complete field coverage even when vector glyph transport
is sampled.
parameters.name: max_samples
